data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2017 (opening for 2018) of approximately 77.507 million (reporting currency). The report discusses material natural catastrophe exposures (notably Hurricanes Harvey and Irma affecting 2017 and Hurricanes Michael and Florence affecting 2018) and mentions reinsurance recoveries; however an explicit gross prioryear (pre-2018) movement amount is not stated in the available notes. The year-end gross claims outstanding decreased by a modest amount during 2018, but no explicit gross prioryear movement figure is provided in the technical reserves movement notes accessible in the document.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (31 Dec 2018 comparative column = 31 Dec 2017 closing). The report's functional/presentational currency is USD. An explicit gross prior-year (pre-2018) movement figure (movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding) could not be located in the pages scanned; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Named catastrophes (Harvey, Irma, Michael, Florence) are mentioned in the managing agent text but no quantification by event or by line of business was provided in the accessible notes. Premium mix is taken from the segment showing reinsurance acceptances; class names copied as presented in the document image. No usable gross claims development triangle was found in the scanned pages (or it was illegible), so triangle fields are empty.
